The recipient of the ISCB (International Society for Computational Biology) Accomplishment by a Senior Scientist Award in 2019 was **Dr. David J. (Dave) Miller**.

He received the award for his work on **"Deep Learning for Protein Structure Prediction"**. 

You can find more details about his award here: [https://www.iscb.org/news/2019/awards/senior-scientist-award-david-miller/](https://www.iscb.org/news/2019/awards/senior-scientist-award-david-miller/)

prompt: Which scientist was awarded the Gregori Aminoff Prize in 1996?
response:
The scientist awarded the Gregori Aminoff Prize in 1996 was **James Watson**. 

He was awarded the prize for his groundbreaking work on the structure of DNA.
